fields.finding: NASA E595 uses 125 C for 24 h. TML is neither kg/day at 284.9 K nor a certified finite flight inventory. Historical cures/lots and several material/gauge proxies differ. CVCM is a subset, not added to TML.
fields.proposed_next: Obtain actual material inventory and service-temperature desorption curves; retain unmatched-data tags.
